title: Welcome to PdskWork
excerpt: A cyberpunk portfolio for the liquid-glass era — built with Next.js 16, React Three Fiber, and Motion.
content:
# Welcome to PdskWork

This is the inaugural post on the **PdskWork** blog. Here we share process notes, behind-the-scenes breakdowns of the 3D scenes and shaders, and iteration retrospectives.

## What to expect

- **Deep dives** into the React Three Fiber hero scenes and the FBM fresnel background shader.
- **Performance** write-ups: Cache Components, Partial Prefetching, and LazyMotion bundle tuning.
- **Accessibility** notes on `prefers-reduced-motion` and AA contrast.

> Cyberpunk creations for the liquid-glass era.

Stay tuned — more posts coming soon.

# Selamat Datang di PdskWork

Ini adalah postingan pertama di blog **PdskWork**. Di sini kami membagikan catatan proses, uraian di balik layar adegan 3D dan shader, serta retrospektif iterasi.

## Yang bisa diharapkan

- **Bedah mendalam** adegan hero React Three Fiber dan shader latar FBM fresnel.
- **Performa**: Cache Components, Partial Prefetching, dan penalaan bundle LazyMotion.
- **Aksesibilitas**: catatan tentang `prefers-reduced-motion` dan kontras AA.

> Karya cyberpunk untuk era liquid-glass.

Nantikan — lebih banyak postingan segera hadir.
